description: Cover: tracker with demo progress (8 of 55 earned), kind and grade filters, spoiler shield, export/import, the full checklist with official names, descriptions and grades, and The Shootist guide panel open with its target and sources.
Roadmap to the platinum: the six stages built from the official descriptions with per-stage trophy chips and earned counts, followed by the missables panel.
Collectible guide detail: Don't Touch My Deck open beside the checklist, showing the 3 Collectible Card sets target, the full own-words guide, its roadmap stage and its cited sources.
Spoiler shield on with the missable filter: story trophies masked as Hidden story trophy until earned, and every missable trophy flagged with its MISSABLE badge.
